definitions.explanation: The male reproductive organ of a flower, which produces and holds pollen. Contrasted with the {雌|め}しべ (pistil), the female part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雄|お}しべ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: to observe the stamen of a flower.
Pollen is attached to the tip of the stamen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{雄|お}しべ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雌|め}しべ→雌しべ：29508_meshibe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: In science class we learned the roles of the stamen and the pistil.

notes:
The male reproductive part of a flower, which produces and holds pollen. Usually written in kana, or as {雄|お}しべ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄|お}しべ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雌|め}しべ→雌しべ：29508_meshibe⟧: stamen and pistil
- {雄|お}しべ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧: the pollen of the stamen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雌|め}しべ→雌しべ：29508_meshibe⟧: pistil — the female reproductive organ of a flower
- ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧: pollen — the powder produced by the stamen
